manifest.name: Spotify
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Play Spotify through the Spotify app, controlled from Parachord.
manifest.requirement: Needs Spotify Premium, the Spotify app and your own free Spotify developer Client ID.

account.signInHint: Sign in to play from Spotify

clientKeys.label: Client ID
clientKeys.help: Spotify requires your own API credentials. Create a free app to get your Client ID. The Spotify account that creates the app needs Spotify Premium, and the app stops working if that Premium lapses.
steps: Create a new app (name it anything)
Add both redirect URIs below to it
Under “APIs used”, tick both Web API and Web Playback SDK
Copy your Client ID and paste it below
clientKeys.redirectHint: Add both URLs to your Spotify app’s redirect URIs (IPv4 and IPv6).

startup.hint: Parachord plays Spotify songs through the Spotify app, so it has to be open. This opens it in the background when Parachord starts.
